Plot Biomasses

```{r}
biomasses <- weekly_biomasses |> 
  filter(station_name == "BY31 LANDSORTSDJ") |> 
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(sample_week, biomass, colour = node_name)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = color_mapping) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 0.5)
  
  plotly::ggplotly(biomasses)
```

# Production and predation pressure

## Phytoplankton

```{r}
biomasses <- weekly_biomasses |> 
  filter(station_name == "BY31 LANDSORTSDJ") |> 
  select(node_name, biomass, sample_week)

node_data


phytoplankton <- all_fluxes |> 
  group_by(node_name = prey, sample_week) |> 
  summarise(flux_mean = sum(flux_mean)) |>
  left_join(biomasses, by = join_by(node_name, sample_week)) |> 
  mutate(predation_pressure = flux_mean / biomass) |>
  left_join(node_data) |> 
  filter(type == "phytoplankton") |> 
  pivot_longer(3:5, names_to = "metric") |> 
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(sample_week, value, colour = node_name)) +
  facet_wrap("metric", scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_mapping)

plotly::ggplotly(phytoplankton)
```

## Seasonal Predation pressure

```{r}
phyto_biomass <- biomasses |> 
  left_join(node_data) |>
  filter(type == "phytoplankton") |> 
  group_by(sample_week) |> 
  summarise(phyto_biomass = sum(biomass))

zoo_biomass <- biomasses |> 
  left_join(node_data) |>
  filter(type == "zooplankton") |> 
  group_by(sample_week) |> 
  summarise(zoo_biomass = sum(biomass))


transf_eff <- 
  all_fluxes |> 
  group_by(node_name = predator, sample_week) |> 
  summarise(in_flux = sum(flux_mean)) |> 
  left_join(node_data) |> 
  group_by(type, sample_week) |> 
  summarise(in_flux = sum(in_flux)) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "type", values_from = "in_flux") |> 
  left_join(phyto_biomass) |> 
  left_join(zoo_biomass) |> 
  mutate(phyto_pressure = zooplankton / phyto_biomass,
         zoo_pressure = fish/zoo_biomass) |> 
  pivot_longer(6:7) |> 
  mutate(week = isoweek(sample_week),
         year = factor(year(sample_week))) |> 
  
  
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(week, value, colour = year), alpha = 0.5) +
  theme( axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)) +
  facet_wrap("name", ncol = 1) +
    theme_minimal()

plotly::ggplotly(transf_eff)
  
```


# Seasonal diet composition

## Fish

```{r}
all_fluxes |> 
  left_join(node_data, by = c("predator" = "node_name")) |> 
  filter(type == "fish") |>
  group_by(predator, sample_week) |> 
  summarise(flux = flux_mean/sum(flux_mean),
            prey) |> 
  ggplot() +
  geom_area(aes(sample_week, flux, fill = prey), position = "fill", alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap("predator", ncol = 1)



all_fluxes
```

# Diet Overlap

Bray Curtis diet similarity of fish over the seasons.

```{r}
library(vegan)

all_fluxes |> 
  left_join(node_data, by = c("predator" = "node_name")) |> 
  filter(type == "fish") |>
  group_by(predator, sample_week) |> 
  summarise(flux = flux_mean/sum(flux_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            prey) |> 
group_by(sample_week) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(overlap = map(data, function(week_data) {
    # Create predator x prey matrix of energy fluxes
    diet_matrix <- week_data %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = prey, values_from = flux, values_fill = 0) %>%
      column_to_rownames("predator") %>%
      as.matrix()
    
    # Bray-Curtis dissimilarity (lower = more similar)
    dist <- vegdist(diet_matrix, method = "bray")
    
    # Convert to tidy data frame of pairwise similarities (1 - dissimilarity)
    sim <- as.matrix(1 - dist)
    combn(rownames(sim), 2, simplify = FALSE) %>%
      map_df(~ tibble(
        predator1 = .x[1],
        predator2 = .x[2],
        overlap = sim[.x[1], .x[2]]
      ))
  })) |> 
  select(sample_week, overlap) %>%
  unnest(overlap) |> 
  mutate(pair = paste(predator1, predator2)) |> 
  mutate(week = isoweek(sample_week),
         year = factor(year(sample_week))) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = overlap,
             color = year)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap("pair", ncol = 1) +
  labs(x = "Week", y = "Diet Overlap", color = "Predator Pair") +
  theme_minimal()
```
